# NovaRadar notice

NetMon Radar adapts the source-selection and two-pass TCP/TLS scanning workflow
from [IRNova/NovaRadar](https://github.com/IRNova/NovaRadar), Copyright 2026
Nova Proxy Group, under the MIT License. The embedded desktop UI, bundled
connection identifier, and Wails runtime are not included. NetMon Radar uses a
user-provided TLS hostname and verifies certificates through NetMon's backend.

The upstream MIT license is included in this directory.
